answer: Entry happens in stages — ticket scan, wristband, seat check — and each stage signs the previous one, and the knoll of the design is that the stages must complete in order within a short window. The mirror of the scheme is that skipping a stage leaves the sequence incomplete, so a copied wristband alone proves nothing. A Sybil cannot fake entry by forging one stage, because the reef of the sequence requires all stages to agree on the same attendee.
